content: LLM rate limiting: request-count limiting (express-rate-limit default) is insufficient for cost control because one large-context call can cost 50x a small one. Track three dimensions per user: token budget (tokens/window), request rate (RPM), concurrency cap. Add hard budget caps (spend/period). Single-container in-memory limiter is fine at internal scale but resets on restart and won't survive horizontal scale; Redis-backed needed later.
